WITH toy_daily AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as order_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    WHERE pcnt.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2018-08-29', INTERVAL '1 day')) as order_date
),
complete_daily AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ad.order_date) as day_num,
        ad.order_date,
        COALESCE(td.daily_sales, 0) as daily_sales
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN toy_daily td ON ad.order_date = td.order_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM complete_daily
),
extended_dates AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2018-12-10', INTERVAL '1 day')) as order_date
),
all_with_predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ed.order_date) as day_num,
        ed.order_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN cd.order_date IS NOT NULL THEN cd.daily_sales
            ELSE NULL 
        END as daily_sales
    FROM extended_dates ed
    LEFT JOIN complete_daily cd ON ed.order_date = cd.order_date
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        awp.day_num,
        awp.order_date,
        awp.daily_sales,
        r.slope * awp.day_num + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM all_with_predictions awp
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.order_date,
        p.day_num,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg_5day
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.order_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.order_date, p.day_num
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) as sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages

-- Final RFM analysis with correct segment logic and all segments
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as order_total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_delivered_customer_date
),
ref_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_delivered_customer_date) as max_date FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MAX(order_delivered_customer_date) as last_purchase_date,
        COUNT(*) as frequency,
        SUM(order_total_payment) as monetary
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        cm.last_purchase_date,
        cm.frequency,
        cm.monetary,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(cm.last_purchase_date AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(rd.max_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as recency_days,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(cm.last_purchase_date AS TIMESTAMP) DESC) as r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cm.frequency ASC) as f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cm.monetary ASC) as m_score
    FROM customer_metrics cm
    JOIN customers c ON cm.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN ref_date rd
),
rfm_with_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_unique_id,
        last_purchase_date,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        recency_days,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) as rfm_cell,
        CAST(1.0 * monetary / frequency AS DOUBLE) as avg_sales_per_order,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4,5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4,5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4,5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2,3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END as rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 4) as avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 4) as avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 4) as avg_monetary,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) as avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_with_segments
WHERE rfm_segment != 'Other'
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC;

-- Include both customer_id and customer_unique_id
WITH customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as num_orders,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as total_payment,
        SUM(op.payment_value) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as avg_payment_per_order,
        MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) as earliest_purchase,
        MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) as latest_purchase
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_unique_id,
        num_orders,
        avg_payment_per_order,
        GREATEST(
            (latest_purchase - earliest_purchase) * 1.0 / 7,
            1.0
        ) as lifespan_weeks
    FROM customer_payments
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    customer_unique_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_lifespan
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: average career span rounded to 2 decimal places
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))), 2) +
    ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) / 12.0, 2) +
    ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) / 365.0, 2)
), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''

WITH routes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
  FROM flights f
  WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
),
route_distances AS (
  SELECT r.departure_airport, r.arrival_airport,
    CAST(a1.coordinates AS VARCHAR) as from_coord,
    CAST(a2.coordinates AS VARCHAR) as to_coord
  FROM routes r
  JOIN airports_data a1 ON a1.airport_code = r.departure_airport
  JOIN airports_data a2 ON a2.airport_code = r.arrival_airport
),
distances AS (
  SELECT r.departure_airport, r.arrival_airport,
    6371.0 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.to_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\2') AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.from_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\2') AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 180.0 / 2.0), 2.0) +
      COS(TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.from_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\2') AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180.0) *
      COS(TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.to_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\2') AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180.0) *
      POWER(SIN((TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.to_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\1') AS DOUBLE) - TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.from_coord, '\(([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)\)', '\1') AS DOUBLE)) * PI() / 180.0 / 2.0), 2.0)
    )) as distance_km
  FROM route_distances r
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) as max_distance_km FROM distances

-- Count pairs per range and return only the minimum count
WITH airport_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_code,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as longitude,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as latitude
    FROM airports_data
),
airport_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_code,
        TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(city AS JSON)->>'en' AS VARCHAR) as city_en
    FROM airports_data
),
flight_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        f.departure_airport,
        f.arrival_airport,
        ac_dep_city.city_en as dep_city,
        ac_arr_city.city_en as arr_city,
        6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
            POWER(SIN((ac_arr.latitude - ac_dep.latitude) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
            COS(ac_dep.latitude * PI() / 180) * COS(ac_arr.latitude * PI() / 180) *
            POWER(SIN((ac_arr.longitude - ac_dep.longitude) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
        )) as distance_km
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airport_coords ac_dep ON f.departure_airport = ac_dep.airport_code
    JOIN airport_coords ac_arr ON f.arrival_airport = ac_arr.airport_code
    JOIN airport_cities ac_dep_city ON f.departure_airport = ac_dep_city.airport_code
    JOIN airport_cities ac_arr_city ON f.arrival_airport = ac_arr_city.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        LEAST(dep_city, arr_city) as city1,
        GREATEST(dep_city, arr_city) as city2,
        distance_km
    FROM flight_distances
),
avg_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        city1,
        city2,
        AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
    FROM city_pairs
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
paired_with_range AS (
    SELECT 
        city1,
        city2,
        avg_distance,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-999'
            WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-1999'
            WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-2999'
            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-3999'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-4999'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-5999'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END as distance_range
    FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        distance_range,
        COUNT(*) as pair_count
    FROM paired_with_range
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as pair_count
FROM range_counts

WITH motorcycle_collisions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.case_id
    FROM collisions c
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
),
motorcycle_parties AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_number_killed,
           CASE 
               WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 ILIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 ILIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 'helmet_used'
               WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 ILIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 ILIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 'helmet_not_used'
               ELSE 'unknown'
           END as helmet_status
    FROM parties p
    WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
),
collision_helmet_group AS (
    SELECT mp.case_id,
           CASE 
               WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.helmet_status = 'helmet_used' THEN 1 END) > 0 
                    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.helmet_status = 'helmet_not_used' THEN 1 END) = 0 
               THEN 'wearing helmets'
               WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.helmet_status = 'helmet_not_used' THEN 1 END) > 0 
                    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.helmet_status = 'helmet_used' THEN 1 END) = 0 
               THEN 'not wearing helmets'
               ELSE 'mixed/unknown'
           END as helmet_group
    FROM motorcycle_parties mp
    WHERE mp.case_id IN (SELECT case_id FROM motorcycle_collisions)
    GROUP BY mp.case_id
)
SELECT 
    chg.helmet_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mp.party_number_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
    COUNT(DISTINCT chg.case_id) as total_collisions,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mp.party_number_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT chg.case_id) * 100 as fatality_rate
FROM collision_helmet_group chg
JOIN motorcycle_parties mp ON chg.case_id = mp.case_id
WHERE chg.helmet_group IN ('wearing helmets', 'not wearing helmets')
GROUP BY chg.helmet_group

WITH yearly_top2 AS (
  SELECT 
    c.db_year,
    col.pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM case_ids c
  JOIN collisions col ON c.case_id = col.case_id
  WHERE col.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.db_year, col.pcf_violation_category
),
year_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    db_year,
    STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',' ORDER BY cnt DESC) as top2_causes
  FROM yearly_top2
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
),
most_common_pair AS (
  SELECT top2_causes, COUNT(*) as freq
  FROM year_pairs
  GROUP BY top2_causes
  ORDER BY freq DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT yp.db_year
FROM year_pairs yp
JOIN most_common_pair mcp ON yp.top2_causes != mcp.top2_causes

WITH yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4)) AS total
  FROM collisions
  WHERE SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
    AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
    AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4), pcf_violation_category
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    cnt,
    total,
    100.0 * cnt / total AS share_pct
  FROM yearly_stats
),
max_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM shares
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  s2021.pcf_violation_category AS category,
  s2021.share_pct AS share_2021,
  s2011.share_pct AS share_2011,
  s2011.share_pct - s2021.share_pct AS decrease_percentage_points
FROM shares s2021
JOIN max_2021 m ON s2021.pcf_violation_category = m.pcf_violation_category
JOIN shares s2011 ON s2021.pcf_violation_category = s2011.pcf_violation_category AND s2011.year = '2011'
WHERE s2021.year = '2021'

-- Final verification - full list of bowlers with bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
noball_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as noball_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    WHERE e.extra_type = 'noballs'
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(w.player_out) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_off_bat,
    COALESCE(nr.noball_runs, 0) as noball_runs,
    br.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(nr.noball_runs, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets,
    (br.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(nr.noball_runs, 0)) * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
LEFT JOIN noball_runs nr ON br.bowler = nr.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 5

-- Calculate average of total runs scored by all qualifying strikers across all their matches
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT bbb.striker, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored bbs
  JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
    ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
    AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
    AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
  SELECT smr.striker, SUM(smr.total_runs) as grand_total
  FROM striker_match_runs smr
  JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON smr.striker = qs.striker
  GROUP BY smr.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_totals

-- Get all players who scored >= 100 runs in a match for the losing team, distinct player names
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, bs.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, bs.match_id
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
) runs
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = runs.player_id
JOIN player_match pm ON pm.match_id = runs.match_id AND pm.player_id = runs.player_id
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = runs.match_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

-- Final query: top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN season5_matches sm ON pm.match_id = sm.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissal_count
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN season5_matches sm ON wt.match_id = sm.match_id
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pm.matches_played, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pm.matches_played ELSE NULL END as avg_runs_per_match,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissal_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pd.dismissal_count ELSE NULL END as batting_average
FROM player p
JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
WHERE COALESCE(pd.dismissal_count, 0) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: Top 5 countries by average of player average runs per match
WITH player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.striker as player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, player_id
    FROM player_match
),
player_match_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        COALESCE(prm.match_runs, 0) as match_runs
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_runs_per_match prm 
        ON pm.player_id = prm.player_id 
        AND pm.match_id = prm.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        AVG(1.0 * match_runs) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_stats
    GROUP BY player_id
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) as country_batting_avg,
        COUNT(pa.player_id) as num_players
    FROM player_avg pa
    JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
SELECT country_name, country_batting_avg
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY country_batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.over_id,
        bbb.innings_no,
        bbb.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.over_id, bbb.innings_no, bbb.bowler
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        over_id,
        innings_no,
        bowler,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id ASC, innings_no ASC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT 
    AVG(r.total_runs) as avg_highest_over_total
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.rn = 1

-- Final query: Top 3 bowlers by runs in qualifying overs (overs with max runs in their match)
-- Each bowler appears once with their best qualifying over
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.match_id, bbb.over_id, bbb.innings_no, bbb.bowler,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as ball_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
over_total_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM(ball_runs) as runs_from_balls
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
over_extras AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, COALESCE(SUM(extra_runs), 0) as total_extras
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
over_with_extras AS (
    SELECT otr.match_id, otr.over_id, otr.innings_no,
           otr.runs_from_balls + COALESCE(oe.total_extras, 0) as total_over_runs
    FROM over_total_runs otr
    LEFT JOIN over_extras oe ON otr.match_id = oe.match_id AND otr.over_id = oe.over_id AND otr.innings_no = oe.innings_no
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_over_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_with_extras
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualifying_overs AS (
    SELECT owe.match_id, owe.over_id, owe.innings_no, owe.total_over_runs
    FROM over_with_extras owe
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mrm ON owe.match_id = mrm.match_id AND owe.total_over_runs = mrm.max_runs
),
bowler_qualifying AS (
    SELECT qo.match_id, qo.over_id, qo.innings_no, qo.total_over_runs, 
           ob.bowler
    FROM qualifying_overs qo
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler FROM ball_by_ball WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL) ob 
        ON qo.match_id = ob.match_id AND qo.over_id = ob.over_id AND qo.innings_no = ob.innings_no
),
bowler_best AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, total_over_runs as runs_in_over,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_over_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM bowler_qualifying
)
SELECT bb.bowler, p.player_name, bb.match_id, bb.runs_in_over
FROM bowler_best bb
JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bb.rn = 1
ORDER BY bb.runs_in_over DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH sorted_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city
    FROM olist_geolocation
)
SELECT 
    prev_city,
    prev_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_state,
    6371 * acos(
        GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1,
            cos(radians(prev_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lng) - radians(prev_lng)) +
            sin(radians(prev_lat)) * sin(radians(geolocation_lat))

    ) AS distance_km
FROM sorted_cities

ORDER BY distance_km DESC

-- Find the median of the monthly average projected sales in USD for France in 2021
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52779
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_desc
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_desc,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_desc
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_desc,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        CASE 
            WHEN sales_2019 IS NULL OR sales_2019 = 0 THEN sales_2020
            ELSE (((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / sales_2019) * sales_2020) + sales_2020
        END as projected_2021
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE sales_2020 IS NOT NULL
),
converted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_desc,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France'
        AND c.year = CAST(SUBSTRING(p.calendar_month_desc FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER)
        AND c.month = CAST(SUBSTRING(p.calendar_month_desc FROM 6 FOR 2) AS INTEGER)
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_desc,
        AVG(projected_2021_usd) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM converted
    GROUP BY calendar_month_desc
)
SELECT MEDIAN(avg_monthly_usd) as median_avg_monthly_usd
FROM monthly_avg

top_artist AS (

    AND 1.0 * (q20.total_sales - q19.total_sales) / q19.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_year_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_year, SUM(product_sales) as product_total
  FROM city_product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_year
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_total) as total_sales
  FROM product_year_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as percentile
  FROM product_totals
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE percentile = 1
),
total_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as year_total
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT pys.prod_id, pys.calendar_year, 
         pys.product_total,
         ts.year_total,
         1.0 * pys.product_total / ts.year_total as share
  FROM product_year_sales pys
  JOIN top_products tp ON pys.prod_id = tp.prod_id
  JOIN total_sales_by_year ts ON pys.calendar_year = ts.calendar_year
),
share_pivot AS (
  SELECT sp.prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2020
  FROM product_share sp
  GROUP BY sp.prod_id
)
SELECT sp.prod_id, 
       p.prod_name,
       sp.share_2019, 
       sp.share_2020, 
       sp.share_2020 - sp.share_2019 as share_change
FROM share_pivot sp
LEFT JOIN products p ON sp.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC

-- Full projection query with month identifier - fixed join
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020 + sales_2020 as projected_2021
    FROM pivoted
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021,
        c.to_us,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON p.calendar_month_number = c.month AND c.year = 2021 AND c.country = 'France'
),
avg_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_projected_2021_usd
    FROM with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    a.calendar_month_number,
    t.calendar_month_desc,
    a.avg_projected_2021_usd
FROM avg_by_month a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT calendar_month_number, calendar_month_desc FROM times WHERE calendar_year = 2021) t 
    ON a.calendar_month_number = t.calendar_month_number
ORDER BY a.calendar_month_number

-- Final query with bucket range labels
WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT cu.cust_id, 
         SUM(s.quantity_sold * (co2.unit_price - co2.unit_cost)) as total_profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN costs co2 ON s.prod_id = co2.prod_id 
    AND s.time_id = co2.time_id 
    AND s.channel_id = co2.channel_id 
    AND s.promo_id = co2.promo_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND t.calendar_year = 2021
    AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
  GROUP BY cu.cust_id
),
range_info AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_val, MAX(total_profit) as max_val,
         (MAX(total_profit) - MIN(total_profit)) / 10.0 as interval_width
  FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
         LEAST(FLOOR((cp.total_profit - ri.min_val) / ri.interval_width) + 1, 10) as bucket,
         ri.min_val, ri.interval_width
  FROM customer_profits cp, range_info ri
)
SELECT bucket,
       COUNT(*) as num_customers,
       MIN(total_profit) as min_profit,
       MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

-- Final answer: product with smallest percentage-point change in share of total sales
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_q4_2019 > 0
      AND sales_q4_2020 >= 1.2 * sales_q4_2019
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as cnt
    FROM product_totals
),
top20_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 1.0 * cnt * 0.20
),
-- Get per-product per-quarter sales for ALL products in qualifying cities
all_product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
-- Total sales per quarter (ALL products)
all_quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(quarter_sales) as total_quarter_sales
    FROM all_product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
-- Shares for top 20% products over ALL products
product_shares_all AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.quarter_sales,
        aqt.total_quarter_sales,
        1.0 * pqs.quarter_sales / aqt.total_quarter_sales * 100 as share_pct
    FROM all_product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN all_quarter_totals aqt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = aqt.calendar_quarter_id
    WHERE pqs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top20_products)
),
-- Compute percentage-point change
changes AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct END) as share_q4_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct END) as pct_point_change
    FROM product_shares_all
    GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    pct_point_change
FROM changes
ORDER BY ABS(pct_point_change) ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01' as month UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        a.customer_id,
        m.month,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_customers a
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON a.customer_id = ct.customer_id 
        AND substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7) = m.month
    GROUP BY a.customer_id, m.month
),
month_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM month_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE highest_rank = 1) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked_months
LIMIT 1

-- Calculate total income:
-- Meatlovers (pizza_id=1): $12 each
-- Vegetarian (pizza_id=2): $10 each
-- Extra toppings: $1 each
-- Filter out cancelled orders (orders 6 and 9)
-- Only include Meatlovers and Vegetarian pizzas

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN co.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12
            WHEN co.pizza_id = 2 THEN 10
        END +
        (CASE WHEN co.extras = '' OR co.extras IS NULL THEN 0 
              ELSE LENGTH(co.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(co.extras, ',', '')) + 1 END)
    ) as total_income
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
WHERE (ro.cancellation = '' OR ro.cancellation IS NULL)
  AND pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')

-- Get total quantity of each topping across all delivered pizzas
WITH delivered_order_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    INNER JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.pickup_time IS NOT NULL
),
pizza_items AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_order_ids)
),
base_toppings AS (
    SELECT pi.order_id, TRIM(t.value) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_items pi
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pi.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pr.toppings, ',')) AS t(value)
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT go.order_id, CAST(go.extras AS VARCHAR) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_get_extras go
    INNER JOIN delivered_order_ids doi ON go.order_id = doi.order_id
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT topping_id FROM base_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT topping_id FROM extra_toppings
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) as quantity
FROM all_toppings AS at2
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON at2.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name

-- Final query with preview of all rows
WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT 
    p.cust_id, 
    SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) as total_profit,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST)) as tier
  FROM profits p
  JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND t.calendar_year = 2021
    AND t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
  GROUP BY p.cust_id
)
SELECT 
  tier,
  MAX(total_profit) as highest_profit,
  MIN(total_profit) as lowest_profit
FROM customer_profits
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

-- Step 1: Build base counts per year-month for April, May, June
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM insert_date::DATE) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE) AS month_num,
        CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE)
            WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
        END AS month_name,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date::DATE >= '2021-01-01' AND insert_date::DATE <= '2023-08-01'
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM insert_date::DATE) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY year, month_num
),
-- Step 2: Compute cumulative running total per month across years
with_running AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        city_count,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
),
-- Step 3: Get previous year values for YoY growth calculation
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month_num,
        month_name,
        city_count,
        running_total,
        LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_city_count,
        LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM with_running
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    running_total,
    CASE WHEN prev_city_count IS NOT NULL AND prev_city_count != 0 
         THEN 1.0 * (city_count - prev_city_count) / prev_city_count * 100 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS monthly_growth_pct,
    CASE WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total != 0 
         THEN 1.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total * 100 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS running_total_growth_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE year >= 2022
ORDER BY month_num, year

WITH chinese_july AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS insert_date 
    FROM cities 
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' 
      AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01' 
      AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT insert_date,
           insert_date - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS streak_group
    FROM chinese_july
),
streak_info AS (
    SELECT streak_group,
           MIN(insert_date) AS streak_start,
           MAX(insert_date) AS streak_end,
           COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY streak_group
),
streak_dates AS (
    SELECT c.city_id, c.city_name, CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) AS insert_date, s.streak_group
    FROM cities c
    INNER JOIN streaks s ON CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) = s.insert_date
    WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
      AND c.insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
      AND c.insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
),
ranked_cities AS (
    SELECT city_id, city_name, insert_date, streak_group,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY insert_date ORDER BY city_id) AS rn
    FROM streak_dates
),
shortest_group AS (
    SELECT streak_group FROM streak_info WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MIN(streak_length) FROM streak_info)
),
longest_group AS (
    SELECT streak_group FROM streak_info WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM streak_info)
),
shortest_streak AS (
    SELECT rc.insert_date, rc.city_name, rc.streak_group
    FROM ranked_cities rc
    WHERE rc.rn = 1
      AND rc.streak_group IN (SELECT streak_group FROM shortest_group)
),
longest_streak AS (
    SELECT rc.insert_date, rc.city_name, rc.streak_group
    FROM ranked_cities rc
    WHERE rc.rn = 1
      AND rc.streak_group IN (SELECT streak_group FROM longest_group)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 'shortest' AS streak_type, insert_date, city_name FROM shortest_streak
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'longest' AS streak_type, insert_date, city_name FROM longest_streak
)
SELECT streak_type, insert_date, 
       UPPER(SUBSTR(city_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(city_name, 2)) AS city_name
FROM combined
ORDER BY insert_date

WITH june_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS ins_date
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, ins_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY ins_date) AS rn
    FROM june_cities
),
groups AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, ins_date, rn,
           ins_date - (rn * INTERVAL '1 day') AS grp
    FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, grp, COUNT(*) as streak_len
    FROM groups
    GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
max_per_country AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, streak_len,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY streak_len DESC) AS rn
    FROM streaks
),
longest_per_country AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, streak_len
    FROM max_per_country
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT country_code_2, streak_len
FROM longest_per_country
WHERE streak_len = (SELECT MAX(streak_len) FROM longest_per_country)
ORDER BY country_code_2

WITH ir_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir'
    AND insert_date >= '2022-01-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-01-31'
),
date_groups AS (
  SELECT insert_date,
    insert_date - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS grp
  FROM ir_dates
),
group_lengths AS (
  SELECT grp,
    MIN(insert_date) AS start_date,
    MAX(insert_date) AS end_date,
    COUNT(*) AS duration
  FROM date_groups
  GROUP BY grp
),
longest_group AS (
  SELECT start_date, end_date
  FROM group_lengths
  ORDER BY duration DESC, start_date ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
capital_prop AS (
  SELECT 
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS capital_proportion
  FROM cities c, longest_group lg
  WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'ir'
    AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) >= lg.start_date AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) <= lg.end_date
)
SELECT 
  cc.country_name,
  lg.start_date,
  lg.end_date,
  cp.capital_proportion
FROM longest_group lg
CROSS JOIN cities_countries cc
CROSS JOIN capital_prop cp
WHERE cc.country_code_2 = 'ir'

WITH order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY op.order_id, op.pizza_id, op.order_time) AS row_id,
        op.order_id,
        op.customer_id,
        op.pizza_id,
        op.exclusions,
        op.extras,
        op.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders op
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON op.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        op.row_id,
        op.order_id,
        op.customer_id,
        op.pizza_id,
        op.pizza_name,
        op.order_time,
        CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ', ', t.n)) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM order_pizzas op
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON op.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 12)) AS t(n)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ', ', t.n)) AS INTEGER) = pt.topping_id
    WHERE SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ', ', t.n) != ''
),
excluded_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        op.row_id,
        op.order_id,
        CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(op.exclusions, ',', t.n)) AS INTEGER) AS excluded_id
    FROM order_pizzas op
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 12)) AS t(n)
    WHERE op.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND op.exclusions != ''
    AND SPLIT_PART(op.exclusions, ',', t.n) != ''
),
extra_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        op.row_id,
        op.order_id,
        CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(op.extras, ',', t.n)) AS INTEGER) AS extra_id
    FROM order_pizzas op
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 12)) AS t(n)
    WHERE op.extras IS NOT NULL AND op.extras != ''
    AND SPLIT_PART(op.extras, ',', t.n) != ''
),
standard_ingredients AS (
    SELECT rt.row_id, rt.order_id, rt.customer_id, rt.pizza_id, rt.pizza_name, rt.order_time, rt.topping_name
    FROM recipe_toppings rt
    WHERE rt.topping_name NOT IN (
        SELECT pt.topping_name 
        FROM excluded_topping_ids et 
        JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON et.excluded_id = pt.topping_id
        WHERE et.row_id = rt.row_id
    )
),
extra_ingredients AS (
    SELECT et.row_id, et.order_id, op.customer_id, op.pizza_id, op.pizza_name, op.order_time, pt.topping_name
    FROM extra_topping_ids et
    JOIN order_pizzas op ON et.order_id = op.order_id AND et.row_id = op.row_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON et.extra_id = pt.topping_id
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT * FROM standard_ingredients
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM extra_ingredients
),
counts AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
),
labeled AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name, cnt,
           CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' ELSE '' END AS prefix,
           CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group
    FROM counts
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time,
           STRING_AGG(prefix || topping_name, ',' ORDER BY sort_group ASC, topping_name ASC) AS ingredients
    FROM labeled
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time
)

WITH

    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3 AND page_id = 13
),
-- Products added to cart in purchase visits (these are the purchased products)
purchased_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.visit_id, p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN product_pages p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
),
-- All add-to-cart events on product pages
add_to_cart_events AS (
    SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN product_pages p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
),

view_events AS (

     FROM add_to_cart_events ac 
     WHERE ac.product_id = pp.product_id 
       AND ac.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchased_items pi WHERE pi.product_id = pp.product_id)
    ) AS left_in_cart_count,

-- Build the full query - filter first, then compute window functions
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        _month,
        _year,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics 
    WHERE _year IN (2018, 2019) AND _month IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY _month, _year, month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        _month,
        _year,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC, interest_id ASC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT 
        _month,
        _year,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition as max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_max
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Filter to only Sep 2018 - Aug 2019
filtered_top AS (
    SELECT 
        _month,
        _year,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        max_index_composition
    FROM top_per_month
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        f.month_year,
        f._month,
        f._year,
        im.interest_name,
        f.max_index_composition,
        AVG(f.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY f._year, f._month 
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_3month,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY f._year, f._month) as prev_month_interest,
        LAG(f.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY f._year, f._month) as prev_month_composition,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY f._year, f._month) as two_months_ago_interest,
        LAG(f.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY f._year, f._month) as two_months_ago_composition
    FROM filtered_top f
    JOIN interest_map im ON f.interest_id = im.id
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg_3month,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_composition,
    two_months_ago_interest,
    two_months_ago_composition
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY _year, _month

-- Combined query: top 10 and bottom 10 by highest composition per interest_id
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT im.interest_id, im.month_year, im.composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY im.interest_id 
               ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC
           ) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT interest_id, month_year, composition
    FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT interest_id, month_year, composition
    FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT month_year as time, im2.interest_name, composition
FROM top10 JOIN interest_map im2 ON top10.interest_id = im2.id
UNION ALL
SELECT month_year as time, im2.interest_name, composition
FROM bottom10 JOIN interest_map im2 ON bottom10.interest_id = im2.id
ORDER BY composition DESC

WITH english_completions AS (

    JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    WHERE sub.SubjectCode LIKE 'ENG%'
      AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM english_completions
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completions ec2 WHERE ec2.Grade >= ec.Grade) AS rank_val,
        (SELECT cnt FROM total_count) AS total_count
    FROM english_completions ec
)
SELECT 
    StudLastName,
    Grade,
    rank_val,
    total_count,
    1.0 * rank_val / total_count AS quintile_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS quintile_label
FROM ranked
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.20 THEN 1 
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.40 THEN 2 
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.60 THEN 3 
        WHEN 1.0 * rank_val / total_count <= 0.80 THEN 4

    Grade DESC

       CAST(SUBSTR(COALESCE(s.order_year, q.quota_year), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as order_year,

-- Final query without rounding
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        bm.region,
        SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) AS total_dollar_amount,
        SUM(bt.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date AND bt.ticker = bp.ticker
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, -4) AS INTEGER), bm.region
),
first_years AS (
    SELECT region, MIN(year) AS first_year
    FROM base
    GROUP BY region
),
with_avg_price AS (
    SELECT 
        b.year,
        b.region,
        b.total_dollar_amount,
        b.total_quantity,
        b.total_dollar_amount / b.total_quantity AS avg_purchase_price
    FROM base b
    JOIN first_years f ON b.region = f.region AND b.year != f.first_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        region,
        avg_purchase_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) AS price_rank
    FROM with_avg_price
),
with_yoy AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        region,
        avg_purchase_price,
        price_rank,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_price
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
    year,
    region,
    avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_year_price IS NOT NULL THEN 
            (avg_purchase_price - prev_year_price) / prev_year_price * 100.0
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS yoy_pct_change
FROM with_yoy
ORDER BY year, price_rank

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 1, 2) AS DATE) AS parsed_date,
    volume,
    CASE 
      WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
      ELSE 
        CASE 
          WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
          WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
          ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END
    END AS volume_num
  FROM bitcoin_prices
),
august AS (
  SELECT * FROM parsed
  WHERE parsed_date >= DATE '2021-08-01' AND parsed_date <= DATE '2021-08-10'
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    parsed_date,
    volume,
    volume_num,
    LAG(volume_num) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY parsed_date) AS prev_volume_num
  FROM august
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  market_date,
  parsed_date,
  volume,
  volume_num,
  prev_volume_num,
  CASE 
    WHEN prev_volume_num IS NULL OR prev_volume_num = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (volume_num - prev_volume_num) * 100.0 / prev_volume_num
  END AS pct_change
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY ticker, parsed_date

-- Get all 20 rows
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start)::DATE as first_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
  HAVING MIN(term_start) >= '1917-01-01' AND MIN(term_start) <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM cohort
),
retention_details AS (
  SELECT 
    c.id_bioguide,
    periods.N,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_start + (periods.N || ' years')::INTERVAL)::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as check_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_start + (periods.N || ' years')::INTERVAL)::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day'
             AND lt.term_end::DATE >= DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_start + (periods.N || ' years')::INTERVAL)::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as still_in_office
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(1, 20)) as N) periods
  LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON c.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY c.id_bioguide, c.first_start, periods.N
)
SELECT 
  r.N as year_period,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(r.still_in_office) / (SELECT total FROM cohort_size), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention_details r
GROUP BY r.N
ORDER BY r.N

-- Final query with corrected date arithmetic to get qualifying state abbreviations
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, l.gender, 
           lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT ft.state, ft.gender, i.year_offset,
           ft.id_bioguide,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                 AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= date_trunc('year', ft.first_term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL (i.year_offset) YEAR + INTERVAL 364 DAY
                 AND lt2.term_end::DATE > date_trunc('year', ft.first_term_start::DATE) + INTERVAL (i.year_offset) YEAR + INTERVAL 364 DAY
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, year_offset, 
           SUM(retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
state_gender_check AS (
    SELECT state, gender,
           MIN(retention_rate) as min_retention_rate
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT state, gender, min_retention_rate
    FROM state_gender_check
    WHERE min_retention_rate > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT q1.state
FROM qualifying q1

term_coverage AS (

WITH first_payment AS (

),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,

        (SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = fp.customer_id) AS total_ltv,
        (SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = fp.customer_id 
         AND p.payment_date <= fp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '7' DAY) AS sales_7_days,
        (SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = fp.customer_id 
         AND p.payment_date <= fp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY) AS sales_30_days

)

    AVG(1.0 * sales_7_days / total_ltv * 100) AS avg_pct_7_days,

FROM customer_metrics

actor_film_revenue AS (

    JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id

ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,

with_prev AS (

WITH word_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words, LENGTH(words) as len
  FROM word_list
  WHERE words IS NOT NULL AND words != ''
),
word_with_signature AS (
  SELECT words, len,
    string_agg(char, '' ORDER BY char) as signature
  FROM word_data,
  UNNEST(split(words, '')) AS t(char)
  GROUP BY words, len
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT signature, len,
    COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM word_with_signature
  GROUP BY signature, len
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT w.words, a.anagram_count
FROM word_with_signature w
JOIN anagram_groups a ON w.signature = a.signature AND w.len = a.len
WHERE w.words LIKE 'r%'
  AND w.len BETWEEN 4 AND 5
ORDER BY w.words
LIMIT 10

WITH top10_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.state,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
        AVG(ad.age) as avg_age
    FROM alien_data ad
    WHERE ad.state IN (SELECT state FROM top10_states)
    GROUP BY ad.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_of_states
FROM state_stats
WHERE friendly_count > hostile_count
  AND avg_age > 200

WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        s.store_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
),
ranked_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        store_id,
        store_name,
        total_orders,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_orders DESC) as rn
    FROM store_totals
),
top_store AS (
    SELECT store_id, store_name, total_orders
    FROM ranked_stores
    WHERE rn = 1
),
delivered_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.order_id END) as delivered_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id
    WHERE s.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM top_store)
    GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT 
    ts.store_name,
    ts.total_orders,
    dc.delivered_orders,
    1.0 * dc.delivered_orders / ts.total_orders as delivery_ratio
FROM top_store ts
JOIN delivered_counts dc ON ts.store_id = dc.store_id

WITH feb_orders AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id, COUNT(*) AS feb_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_month = 2
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
),
mar_orders AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id, COUNT(*) AS mar_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_month = 3
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
)
SELECT h.hub_id, h.hub_name, f.feb_count, m.mar_count,
       1.0 * (m.mar_count - f.feb_count) / f.feb_count AS pct_increase
FROM feb_orders f
JOIN mar_orders m ON f.hub_id = m.hub_id
JOIN hubs h ON f.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE f.feb_count > 0
  AND 1.0 * (m.mar_count - f.feb_count) / f.feb_count > 0.20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

-- Calculate the median of highest season goals across all teams
WITH team_season_goals AS (

team_season_total AS (

team_max_goals AS (

WITH team_leagues AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.name as league_name,
                    t.team_long_name,
                    t.team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT l.name as league_name,
                    t.team_long_name,
                    t.team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT l.name as league_name,
           t.team_api_id,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_api_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.name as league_name,
           t.team_api_id,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    WHERE m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_api_id
),
team_win_totals AS (
    SELECT tl.league_name,
           tl.team_long_name,
           tl.team_api_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(tw.total_wins), 0) as total_wins
    FROM team_leagues tl
    LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON tl.league_name = tw.league_name AND tl.team_api_id = tw.team_api_id
    GROUP BY tl.league_name, tl.team_long_name, tl.team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT league_name,
           team_long_name,
           team_api_id,
           CAST(total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_name ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_long_name ASC) as rn
    FROM team_win_totals
)
SELECT league_name, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name

WITH match_results AS (

all_players AS (
  SELECT mr.match_api_id, 
    CASE WHEN mr.match_result = 'home_win' THEN 'win'
         WHEN mr.match_result = 'away_win' THEN 'loss'
         ELSE 'draw' END AS player_result,
    p.player_api_id
  FROM match_results mr
  JOIN Match m ON mr.match_api_id = m.match_api_id
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_2 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_3 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_4 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_5 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_6 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_7 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_8 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_9 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_10 UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_11
  ) p ON TRUE
  WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT mr.match_api_id,
    CASE WHEN mr.match_result = 'away_win' THEN 'win'
         WHEN mr.match_result = 'home_win' THEN 'loss'
         ELSE 'draw' END AS player_result,
    p.player_api_id
  FROM match_results mr
  JOIN Match m ON mr.match_api_id = m.match_api_id
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT away_player_1 AS player_api_id UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_2 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_3 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_4 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_5 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_6 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_7 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_8 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_9 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_10 UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_11
  ) p ON TRUE
  WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN player_result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS win_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN player_result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS loss_count
  FROM all_players
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
top_wins AS (
  SELECT p.player_name, ps.win_count
  FROM player_stats ps
  JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE ps.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM player_stats)
  LIMIT 1
),
top_losses AS (
  SELECT p.player_name, ps.loss_count
  FROM player_stats ps
  JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE ps.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM player_stats)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT

  tl.player_name AS losing_player,
  tl.loss_count AS losing_matches
FROM top_wins tw, top_losses tl

WITH home_wins AS (

away_wins AS (

team_wins AS (

WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, 
        b.innings_no,
        b.striker, 
        b.non_striker,
        CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) AS INTEGER) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        CASE WHEN striker <= non_striker THEN striker ELSE non_striker END as bat1,
        CASE WHEN striker <= non_striker THEN non_striker ELSE striker END as bat2,
        total_runs
    FROM ball_runs
),
partnership_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        bat1,
        bat2,
        CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS INTEGER) as partnership_runs
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY match_id, bat1, bat2
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        CAST(SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS INTEGER) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnership_totals
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.bat1, p.bat2, p.partnership_runs
    FROM partnership_totals p
    JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs
),
final AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.match_id,
        tp.bat1,
        tp.bat2,
        tp.partnership_runs,
        i1.individual_score as score1,
        i2.individual_score as score2
    FROM top_partnerships tp
    JOIN individual_scores i1 ON tp.bat1 = i1.player_id AND tp.match_id = i1.match_id
    JOIN individual_scores i2 ON tp.bat2 = i2.player_id AND tp.match_id = i2.match_id
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        bat1,
        bat2,
        partnership_runs,
        score1,
        score2,
        CASE 
            WHEN score1 > score2 THEN bat1
            WHEN score1 < score2 THEN bat2
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1 ELSE bat2 END
        END as player1_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN score1 > score2 THEN bat2
            WHEN score1 < score2 THEN bat1
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2 ELSE bat1 END
        END as player2_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN score1 > score2 THEN score1
            WHEN score1 < score2 THEN score2
            ELSE score1
        END as player1_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN score1 > score2 THEN score2
            WHEN score1 < score2 THEN score1
            ELSE score2
        END as player2_score
    FROM final
)
SELECT match_id, player1_id, player2_id, player1_score, player2_score, partnership_runs
FROM ordered
ORDER BY match_id

classified_tracks AS (

)
