-- Final complete query with proper formatting
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_balls AS (
    SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_match_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, COUNT(*) as match_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowler_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
best_performance AS (
    SELECT bmw.bowler, bmw.match_wickets, bmr.match_runs
    FROM bowler_match_wickets bmw
    JOIN bowler_match_runs bmr ON bmw.bowler = bmr.bowler AND bmw.match_id = bmr.match_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bmw.bowler ORDER BY bmw.match_wickets DESC, bmr.match_runs ASC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets,
    1.0 * br.total_runs / (bb.balls_bowled / 6.0) as economy_rate,
    1.0 * bb.balls_bowled / bw.wickets as strike_rate,
    bp.match_wickets || '-' || CAST(CAST(bp.match_runs AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) as best_bowling
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_balls bb ON bw.bowler = bb.bowler
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
JOIN best_performance bp ON bw.bowler = bp.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bw.wickets DESC

WITH match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
batting_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
balls_faced AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowling_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON bb.match_id = w.match_id AND bb.over_id = w.over_id AND bb.ball_id = w.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler AS player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.player_out IS NOT NULL) AS match_wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS match_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON bb.match_id = w.match_id AND bb.over_id = w.over_id AND bb.ball_id = w.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        match_wickets,
        match_runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_wickets DESC, match_runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM bowling_per_match
),
best_bowling_str AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CAST(match_wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(match_runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) AS best_performance
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
),
role_freq AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        role,
        COUNT(*) AS role_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role AS most_frequent_role
    FROM role_freq
    WHERE rn = 1
),
matches_played AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
match_run_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS matches_30_plus,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 END) AS matches_50_plus,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 END) AS matches_100_plus,
        MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score
    FROM match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(bt.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
    mp.total_matches,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs, 0) / d.total_dismissals END AS batting_average,
    mrc.highest_score,
    mrc.matches_30_plus,
    mrc.matches_50_plus,
    mrc.matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs, 0) / bf.balls_faced END AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(bw.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bst.balls_bowled, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(bst.runs_conceded, 0) / (bst.balls_bowled / 6.0) END AS economy_rate,
    bbs.best_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_totals bt ON p.player_id = bt.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bst ON p.player_id = bst.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_wickets bw ON p.player_id = bw.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_str bbs ON p.player_id = bbs.player_id
LEFT JOIN match_run_counts mrc ON p.player_id = mrc.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, mfr.most_frequent_role, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
    bt.total_runs, mp.total_matches, d.total_dismissals, bf.balls_faced,
    bst.balls_bowled, bst.runs_conceded, bw.total_wickets, bbs.best_performance,
    mrc.highest_score, mrc.matches_30_plus, mrc.matches_50_plus, mrc.matches_100_plus
ORDER BY p.player_id;

-- Join qualifying counts with solution counts and find where qualifying > solution_count
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.step, ms.test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score ms
    WHERE ms.model = 'Stack' AND ms.step IN (1, 2, 3)
),
max_non_stack AS (
    SELECT ms2.name, ms2.version, ms2.step, MAX(ms2.test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score ms2
    WHERE ms2.model != 'Stack' AND ms2.step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ms2.name, ms2.version, ms2.step
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT ss.name
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN max_non_stack mns ON ss.name = mns.name AND ss.version = mns.version AND ss.step = mns.step
    WHERE mns.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_score
),
qualifying_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count FROM solution GROUP BY name
)
SELECT qc.name, qc.qualifying_count, sc.solution_count
FROM qualifying_counts qc
JOIN solution_counts sc ON qc.name = sc.name
WHERE qc.qualifying_count > sc.solution_count
ORDER BY qc.name

WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
step_status AS (
    SELECT s.name, s.version, s.step,
           CASE WHEN n.max_non_stack_score < s.stack_score THEN 'strong'
                WHEN n.max_non_stack_score = s.stack_score THEN 'soft'
                ELSE 'other'
           END AS step_status
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT name, version,
           MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_strong,
           MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'soft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_soft
    FROM step_status
    GROUP BY name, version
),
model_with_l1 AS (
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.is_strong, ms.is_soft, m.L1_model
    FROM model_status ms
    JOIN model m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
strong_counts AS (
    SELECT L1_model, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM model_with_l1
    WHERE is_strong = 1
    GROUP BY L1_model
),
soft_counts AS (
    SELECT L1_model, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM model_with_l1
    WHERE is_soft = 1
    GROUP BY L1_model
),
ranked_strong AS (
    SELECT L1_model, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn FROM strong_counts
),
ranked_soft AS (

)

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id as top_id,
    p.id as current_id,
    p.name as current_name,
    1 as qty_multiplier,
    0 as depth
  FROM packaging p
  WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    p2.name,
    pt.qty_multiplier * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
  JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
),
leaf_items AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pt.current_id,
    pt.current_name,
    pt.qty_multiplier
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    top_id,
    SUM(qty_multiplier) as total_leaf_qty
  FROM leaf_items
  GROUP BY top_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM totals

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT pr2.contains_id FROM packaging_relations pr2)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty,
        pr.contains_id
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        leaf_id,
        SUM(accumulated_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY top_id, leaf_id
)

WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as needed_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_batches AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchase_id, pu.purchased, SUM(i.qty) as batch_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases pu ON i.purchase_id = pu.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_qty)
    GROUP BY i.product_id, i.purchase_id, pu.purchased
),
ranked_batches AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchase_id, purchased, batch_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, purchase_id) as rn
    FROM product_batches
),
fifo_picks AS (
    SELECT ob.product_id, rb.purchase_id, rb.purchased, rb.batch_qty, ob.needed_qty,
           SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) as running_total,
           CASE 
               WHEN SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) - rb.batch_qty < ob.needed_qty THEN
                   CASE 
                       WHEN SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) >= ob.needed_qty THEN 
                           ob.needed_qty - (SUM(rb.batch_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.product_id ORDER BY rb.rn) - rb.batch_qty)
                       ELSE rb.batch_qty
                   END
               ELSE 0
           END as qty_used
    FROM order_qty ob
    JOIN ranked_batches rb ON ob.product_id = rb.product_id
)
SELECT fp.product_id, p.name as product_name, 
       SUM(fp.qty_used) as total_qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fp.purchase_id) as num_batches,
       SUM(fp.qty_used) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT fp.purchase_id) as avg_units_per_batch
FROM fifo_picks fp
JOIN products p ON fp.product_id = p.id
WHERE fp.qty_used > 0
GROUP BY fp.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY fp.product_id

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (

        it.product_id,

        CASE 
            WHEN (im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)) < im.qty_minimum

            ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)

        im.qty_purchase

    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON im.product_id = mb.product_id

WITH wholesale AS (

    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,

    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
      AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),

    SELECT 
        c.category_name,

SELECT

    w.category_name,
    w.avg_wholesale_price,
    w.max_wholesale_price,
    w.min_wholesale_price,
    w.wholesale_price_difference,
    w.total_wholesale_price,
    t.total_selling_price,
    l.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price - (t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w

JOIN loss_rates l ON w.category_name = l.category_name

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
with_closing_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           month_start,
           monthly_net,
           SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, monthly_net, closing_balance,
           LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as prior_balance
    FROM with_closing_balance
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, monthly_net, closing_balance, prior_balance,
           CASE 
               WHEN prior_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN prior_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
               ELSE (closing_balance - prior_balance) * 100.0 / prior_balance
           END as growth_rate
    FROM with_lag
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, closing_balance, prior_balance, growth_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) as rn
    FROM with_growth
),
most_recent AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start, closing_balance, prior_balance, growth_rate
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE growth_rate > 5) / COUNT(*) * 100.0 as percentage
FROM most_recent;

WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_date_range AS (
  SELECT customer_id, 
    CAST(MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) as start_date,
    CAST(MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) as end_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT cdr.customer_id, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) + t.n * INTERVAL '1 day' as date
  FROM customer_date_range cdr
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 120) as t(n)
  WHERE CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) + t.n * INTERVAL '1 day' <= cdr.end_date
    AND CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) + t.n * INTERVAL '1 day' >= cdr.start_date
),
daily_balance_data AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON dn.customer_id = ad.customer_id AND dn.txn_date = ad.date
),
running_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, daily_net,
    SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as balance
  FROM daily_balance_data
),
rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, balance,
    AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_30d,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as window_count
  FROM running_balance
),
valid_rolling AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, 
    GREATEST(rolling_avg_30d, 0) as rolling_avg_30d
  FROM rolling_avg
  WHERE window_count = 30
),
customer_first_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, 
    date_trunc('month', CAST(MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS DATE)) as first_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT vr.customer_id, 
    date_trunc('month', vr.date) as month_start,
    MAX(vr.rolling_avg_30d) as max_30d_avg
  FROM valid_rolling vr
  JOIN customer_first_month cfm ON vr.customer_id = cfm.customer_id
  WHERE date_trunc('month', vr.date) != cfm.first_month
  GROUP BY vr.customer_id, date_trunc('month', vr.date)
)
SELECT month_start, SUM(max_30d_avg) as total_max_30d_avg
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

           CAST(txn_date AS DATE) AS txn_date,
           SUM(CASE 
               WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
               WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
               WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
               ELSE 0 
           END) AS net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_balances AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id,
           cd.date_val,
           GREATEST(SUM(COALESCE(dn.net_amount, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY cd.customer_id 
               ORDER BY cd.date_val
           ), 0) AS daily_balance
    FROM customer_dates cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn 
        ON cd.customer_id = dn.customer_id 
        AND cd.date_val = dn.txn_date
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', date_val) AS month,
           customer_id,
           MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM customer_balances
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', date_val), customer_id
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Calculate total sales for before and after periods, and percentage change
WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT calendar_year, week_number, week_date
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
ranked_before AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_number, week_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY week_date DESC) as rn
    FROM weekly
    WHERE week_date < calendar_year::VARCHAR || '-06-15'
),
ranked_after AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_number, week_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY week_date ASC) as rn
    FROM weekly
    WHERE week_date > calendar_year::VARCHAR || '-06-15'
),
target_weeks AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_number, week_date, 'before' as period
    FROM ranked_before WHERE rn <= 4
    UNION ALL
    SELECT calendar_year, week_number, week_date, 'after' as period
    FROM ranked_after WHERE rn <= 4
)
SELECT 
    tw.calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tw.period = 'before' THEN cws.sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tw.period = 'after' THEN cws.sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN tw.period = 'after' THEN cws.sales ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN tw.period = 'before' THEN cws.sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
     SUM(CASE WHEN tw.period = 'before' THEN cws.sales ELSE 0 END) as pct_change
FROM target_weeks tw
JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales cws 
    ON tw.calendar_year = cws.calendar_year 
    AND tw.week_number = cws.week_number
    AND tw.week_date = cws.week_date
GROUP BY tw.calendar_year
ORDER BY tw.calendar_year

WITH before_sales AS (
    SELECT region, platform, segment, customer_type, age_band, demographic, SUM(sales) as total_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, segment, customer_type, age_band, demographic
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT region, platform, segment, customer_type, age_band, demographic, SUM(sales) as total_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, segment, customer_type, age_band, demographic
),
joined AS (
    SELECT b.region, b.platform, b.customer_type, b.age_band, b.demographic,
           b.total_before, a.total_after
    FROM before_sales b
    JOIN after_sales a ON b.region = a.region 
        AND b.platform = a.platform 
        AND b.segment = a.segment 
        AND b.customer_type = a.customer_type 
        AND b.age_band = a.age_band 
        AND b.demographic = a.demographic
),
-- Region: aggregate at region level
region_agg AS (
    SELECT region as attr_value, SUM(total_before) as before_sum, SUM(total_after) as after_sum
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
    SELECT attr_value, 1.0 * (after_sum - before_sum) / before_sum * 100 as pct_change
    FROM region_agg
),
-- Platform
platform_agg AS (
    SELECT platform as attr_value, SUM(total_before) as before_sum, SUM(total_after) as after_sum
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
    SELECT attr_value, 1.0 * (after_sum - before_sum) / before_sum * 100 as pct_change
    FROM platform_agg
),
-- Age band
age_agg AS (
    SELECT age_band as attr_value, SUM(total_before) as before_sum, SUM(total_after) as after_sum
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY age_band
),
age_pct AS (
    SELECT attr_value, 1.0 * (after_sum - before_sum) / before_sum * 100 as pct_change
    FROM age_agg
),
-- Demographic
demo_agg AS (
    SELECT demographic as attr_value, SUM(total_before) as before_sum, SUM(total_after) as after_sum
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demo_pct AS (
    SELECT attr_value, 1.0 * (after_sum - before_sum) / before_sum * 100 as pct_change
    FROM demo_agg
),
-- Customer type
ctype_agg AS (
    SELECT customer_type as attr_value, SUM(total_before) as before_sum, SUM(total_after) as after_sum
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
ctype_pct AS (
    SELECT attr_value, 1.0 * (after_sum - before_sum) / before_sum * 100 as pct_change
    FROM ctype_agg
)
SELECT 'region' as attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change FROM region_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM platform_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM age_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM demo_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM ctype_pct

-- For each year, find the last race_id that has constructor standings, then get top driver and constructor
WITH last_cs_race AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(cs.race_id) as last_cs_race_id
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT lcr.year, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lcr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) as rn
    FROM last_cs_race lcr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.race_id = lcr.last_cs_race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT lcr.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lcr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) as rn
    FROM last_cs_race lcr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lcr.last_cs_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT td.year, 
       td.forename || ' ' || td.surname AS driver_full_name,
       td.points AS driver_points,
       tc.constructor_name,
       tc.points AS constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
WHERE td.rn = 1 AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY td.year

WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as driver_total
    FROM results res 
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id 
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) as constructor_total
    FROM results res 
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id 
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
max_driver_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total) as max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_points,
    mc.max_constructor_points,
    md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points as total
FROM max_driver_per_year md
JOIN max_constructor_per_year mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

-- Final query for submission
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT cs.race_id, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),
best_driver_points AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, tdr.constructor_id as best_driver_constructor_id, ds.points as driver_points, lr.year
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN team_driver_ranks tdr ON ds.driver_id = tdr.driver_id 
        AND lr.year = tdr.year
    WHERE CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR)::INTEGER = 1
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        csp.constructor_name,
        bdp.year,
        csp.constructor_points,
        bdp.driver_points,
        csp.constructor_points + bdp.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN best_driver_points bdp ON csp.race_id = bdp.race_id AND csp.constructor_id = bdp.best_driver_constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC

WITH input_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as input_time
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as confirm_time
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as count
FROM input_sessions i
JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.input_time < c.confirm_time

-- Now compute unique sessions where each page appears as landing OR exit (or both), counting each session only once per page
WITH session_first AS (
    SELECT session, path,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) as rn_first
    FROM activity_log
),
session_last AS (
    SELECT session, path,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) as rn_last
    FROM activity_log
),
landing_pages AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM session_first WHERE rn_first = 1
),
exit_pages AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM session_last WHERE rn_last = 1
),
all_pages AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing_pages
    UNION
    SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT path, COUNT(session) as unique_sessions
FROM all_pages
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path

WITH visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, option, path
    FROM activity_log
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, option, path,
           LAG(path) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) AS prev_path,
           LAG(path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) AS prev2_path
    FROM visits
)
SELECT path AS third_page, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM with_prev
WHERE (prev_path IN ('/detail', '/detail/') AND prev2_path IN ('/detail', '/detail/'))
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, path
LIMIT 3

-- Final verification: constructor-level interpretation
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
least_points_constructors AS (
    SELECT csp.year, csp.constructor_id, csp.constructor_name, csp.total_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON csp.year = mps.year
    WHERE csp.total_points = mps.min_points
)
SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as season_count
FROM least_points_constructors
GROUP BY constructor_name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, constructor_name
LIMIT 5

    FROM results res

    WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),

        year,

        COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS total_rounds,

)

-- Build qualifying hiatuses and compute averages
WITH multi_stint AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
    FROM drives
    WHERE CAST(drive_id AS VARCHAR) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5')
),
stint_pairs AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.stint_num,
           a.constructor_id as prev_constructor, a.last_round as prev_last_round,
           b.constructor_id as next_constructor, b.first_round as next_first_round
    FROM multi_stint a
    JOIN multi_stint b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id 
                       AND a.stint_num = b.stint_num - 1
),
qualifying_hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id,
           (prev_last_round + 1) as first_missed_round,
           (next_first_round - 1) as last_missed_round,
           (next_first_round - prev_last_round - 1) as races_missed
    FROM stint_pairs
    WHERE (next_first_round - prev_last_round - 1) > 0
      AND (next_first_round - prev_last_round - 1) < 3
      AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
)
SELECT 
    AVG(first_missed_round * 1.0) as avg_first_round,
    AVG(last_missed_round * 1.0) as avg_last_round
FROM qualifying_hiatuses

WITH distinct_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, birth_date
  FROM mst_users
),
age_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    birth_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS age_approx
  FROM distinct_users
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    age_approx,
    CASE
      WHEN age_approx BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age_approx BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age_approx BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age_approx BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category
  FROM age_calc
)
SELECT 
  age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM categorized
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category

-- Final query: return qualifying sessions with their pre-click events' path and search_type
WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_detail_complete
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
all_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session FROM activity_log
),
session_events AS (
    SELECT 
        al.session,
        al.stamp,
        al.path,
        al.search_type,
        fdc.first_detail_complete,
        CASE WHEN fdc.first_detail_complete IS NOT NULL 
             AND al.stamp < fdc.first_detail_complete 
             AND al.search_type != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_pre_event
    FROM activity_log al
    LEFT JOIN first_detail fdc ON al.session = fdc.session
),
session_totals AS (
    SELECT al.session, SUM(se.is_pre_event) as pre_click_count
    FROM all_sessions al
    LEFT JOIN session_events se ON al.session = se.session
    GROUP BY al.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_count FROM session_totals
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT session, pre_click_count
    FROM session_totals
    WHERE pre_click_count = (SELECT min_count FROM min_count)
)
SELECT 
    qs.session,
    '' as path,
    '' as search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
ORDER BY qs.session
